boundaries: Only SporeApp.exe 3.1.0.22, committed SDK/field exports, committed decompilation, and read-only PE disassembly are treated as original-game evidence.
OpenSpore source code and the clean-room reimplementation are not used as original-game behavior evidence.

evidence_policy.decompilation: Committed Ghidra exports and committed read-only live-decompiler summaries are behavior evidence, but decompiler casts and comments remain non-authoritative.
evidence_policy.disassembly: Read-only x86 PE disassembly is used for state writes, vtable entries, call ordering, and field offsets where no committed body exists.
evidence_policy.knowledge_graph: The SQLite knowledge graph supplies read-only type, field, xref, and historical observation context; missing call paths are recorded as unresolved.
evidence_policy.runtime: No combat-specific runtime trace was available. Historical Cell animation observations are contextual evidence only and are not promoted to combat state transitions.
evidence_policy.sdk_name_only: SDK names, enum values, field offsets, and vtable slots establish interface shape only unless corroborated by body, disassembly, or runtime evidence.

call_order.claim: The Cell damage path is ordered as attack guard, damage calculation, health commit/clamp, optional health UI, and zero-health death handling.
order: death path when health is zero

The tool interface exposes selection/aiming before firing and hit callbacks, but the concrete manager-to-projectile call order is not established.

ownership.fact: cCellObjectData owns mHealthPoints at +0x244, mIsInvulnerable at +0x111, death-related fields at +0x112 and +0x113, target candidates, and flee/chase timers.
cCreatureBase contains the cCombatant subobject at +0x5a8; cCombatant owns the current-health and maximum-health fields used by generic combatant routines.
cCreatureBase owns the SDK-named in-use ability bitset, recharging ability bitset, and cAbilityState container used by the ability model.
The observed ability-mode setter/getter use global slot 0x0169e394; the full publication and owner lifetime path is not recovered.

state_variable_invariants: The Cell damage resolver clamps mHealthPoints to zero before entering the death path.
The Cell death path writes cCellObjectData+0x113 in the non-player branch.
Target selector values and flee/chase raw timer domains are not semantically named in this artifact.
cCombatant+0x34 is the generic current-health field; the exact death-field writer is unresolved.
The observed ability mode domain is retained as raw 0 and 1 plus an opaque other state; SDK enum labels are not promoted to additional behavior.
Ability in-use and recharging bitsets are tracked independently in the model; their bit-to-ability mapping is unresolved.
Projectile and tool lifecycle states are callback-dependent and are not claimed as a complete runtime state machine.
